content: Element: compositionend event - Web APIs | MDN: The compositionend event is fired when a text composition system such as an input method editor completes or cancels the current composition session (e.g., after entering a Chinese character via Pinyin IME). Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).
conclusion: 明确 compositionend 在输入法会话完成或取消时触发（如中文拼音输入），并提供 generated characters（event.data）。在清空重置时需结合节点闭包与代际隔离，防止旧会话的迟到 compositionend 污染新输入或触发伪空值校验。
